title: Octave Band A-Weighting Calculator
description: Three fixed challenges in which the learner calculates the overall A-weighted sound power level of an eight-band fan spectrum and judges it against a 95 dB limit, followed by a free mode with eight band sliders and a limit slider that update the weighted bands, both totals and the largest contributor.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: octave band sound data
sound power level
A-weighting
logarithmic addition
noise limits
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Comparing octave band sound data with an A-weighted limit
learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the overall A-weighted sound power level from eight octave band levels and judge it against a limit, to within ±0.5 dB.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; unweighted bars are outlines and weighted bars are filled; Enter checks and advances, M/E pick the verdict, sliders and radios work with Tab and arrow keys.

controls.label: Meets / Exceeds
controls.purpose: The learner's verdict against the limit (M / E keys)

controls.label: Next challenge
controls.purpose: Go to the next challenge, or start free mode after challenge 3 (Enter)

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Reset the challenges and the score

controls.label: Reset bands
controls.purpose: Free mode: return the sliders to challenge 1 and a 95 dB limit

controls.label: 63 Hz ... 8,000 Hz
controls.purpose: Free mode: band sound power level, 50 to 110 dB, step 1

controls.label: Limit
controls.purpose: Free mode: A-weighted limit, 70 to 110 dB, step 1

rules: Correct when |entered − model LwA (0.1 dB)| <= 0.5 dB and the meets/exceeds verdict is right
Meets when LwA <= limit; exceeds when LwA > limit
Largest contributor = highest weighted band; ties go to the lower frequency
limitations: Sound power only; no conversion to sound pressure at a listener

sources: Eight-band requirement: Twin City Fan Model RTF guide specification, Section 23 34 16 (tcf.com, Product Specifications in CSI format)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit a number and a verdict before the reveal, then explore band by band
keyQuestions: Which bands control the A-weighted total?
Why can an unweighted total not be compared with an A-weighted limit?
commonMisconceptions: The overall level is the arithmetic average or sum of the band levels
The loudest unweighted band controls the A-weighted total
An unweighted overall level can be compared with an A-weighted limit
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'Challenges correct: n of 3'; mastery is 3 of 3 on the first attempt.
